prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: white-washed stone paving of a southern harbour town, pale limestone slabs, a few blue tile accents The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable top-down JRPG ground texture, 256 x 256 ART pixels, displayed as uniform crisp square pixels enlarged ~7–8x (approximately 2048x2048 output). White-washed stone paving in a southern harbour town: irregular but tidy pale limestone slabs, slightly worn grout seams, sparse small blue ceramic tile accents distributed evenly. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel-art JRPG look, meticulous hand-placed coherent pixel clusters 3–10 art pixels, no isolated speckle. Every pixel is a sharp identical-size square on a perfectly aligned grid: NO anti-aliasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic texture, random noise, checkerboard dithering. Limestone 4–6 earthy shades with warm yellow highlights and subtle more saturated purple-red shade along recessed joints; blue ceramics 4–6 muted blue shades. Natural variation without a central feature. Orthographic steep top-down RPG camera, no perspective convergence. Neutral even upper-left soft overcast evening illumination, clean base colours only; absolutely no cast shadows, darkness, glow, lamps or vignette. Fill entire square with paving surface, no objects, characters, text, border or frame. Crucial: EXACT SEAMLESS WRAP on BOTH axes: all paving shapes, grout seams and pixel clusters intersecting left edge continue exactly at right edge; shapes at top continue exactly at bottom. Even distribution of accents and details over the tile.
